title: facheiroa squamosa subsp. polygona

The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving wound healing due to its antimicrobial and antiseptic actions. The bioactive constituents of Facheiroa squamosa subsp. polygona include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of promoting tissue regeneration and providing antioxidant effects.
